chapter.heading: The Lord’s Reign in Zion
chapter.v:
Now it
shall come to pass in the latter daysThat the mountain of the Lord’s houseShall be established on the top of the mountains,And shall be exalted above the hills;And peoples shall flow to it. [1 Cor. 1:10; 2 Cor. 10:1-4] [Phil. 4:18; Heb.]

Many nations
shall come and say,“Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord,To the house of the God of Jacob;He will teach us His ways,And we shall walk in His paths.”For out of Zion the law shall go forth,And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem. [Matt. 13:22; Gal. 1:4; 1 John 2:15 d Eph. 4:23; [Titus 3:5] e [1 Thess. 4:3]]

He shall
judge between many peoples,And rebuke strong nations afar off;They shall beat their swords into plowshares,And their spears into pruning hooks;Nation shall not lift up sword against nation,Neither shall they learn war anymore. [Rom. 1:5; 15:15; 1 Cor. 3:10; 15:10; Gal. 2:9; Eph. 3:7 g Prov. 25:27 h [Eph. 4:7]]

But everyone
shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree,And no one shall make them afraid;For the mouth of the Lord of hosts has spoken. [1 Cor. 12:12-14; [Eph. 4:4, 16]]

For all
people walk each in the name of his god,But we will walk in the name of the Lord our GodForever and ever.Zion’s Future Triumph [[1 Cor. 10:17]; Gal. 3:28] [Eccl. 8:2 e Acts 24:16; [1 Pet.]

I will
make the lame a remnant,And the outcast a strong nation;So the Lord will reign over them in Mount ZionFrom now on, even forever. [Eph. 4:11] [Matt. 22:21; Mark 12:17; Luke]

And you,
O tower of the flock,The stronghold of the daughter of Zion,To you shall it come,Even the former dominion shall come,The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.” [[Matt. 7:12; 22:39; John 13:34; Rom. 13:10; Gal. 5:13, 14; 1 Tim. 1:5; James 2:8]]

Now why
do you cry aloud?Is there no king in your midst?Has your counselor perished?For pangs have seized you like a woman in labor. [2 Cor. 6:6; 1 Tim. 1:5 s Ps.] [Lev. 19:18; Mark 12:31; James 2:8 2 NU] [Ex. 20:13-17; Deut. 5:17-21; Matt. 19:18 37:21; Matt. 5:42). except to love: Love is a debt that is never]

Be in
pain, and labor to bring forth,O daughter of Zion,Like a woman in birth pangs.For now you shall go forth from the city,You shall dwell in the field,And to Babylon you shall go.There you shall be delivered;There the Lord will redeem youFrom the hand of your enemies. [[Matt. 7:12; 22:39, 40; John 13:34]; Rom. 13:8; Gal. 5:14; James] [Rom. 13:7; Phil. 2:3; [1 Pet. 2:17]] [John 13:34; 1 Thess. 4:9; Heb. 13:1; 2 Pet. 1:7]

Now also
many nations have gathered against you,Who say, “Let her be defiled,And let our eye look upon Zion.” [Mark 13:37; [1 Cor. 15:34; Eph. 5:14]; 1 Thess. 5:6]

But they
do not know the thoughts of the Lord,Nor do they understand His counsel;For He will gather them like sheaves to the threshing floor. [Luke 18:1] [Eph. 5:11 m [2 Cor. 6:7; 10:4; Eph. 6:11, 13; 1 Thess. 5:8]] [Luke 21:19] [Luke 10:20]

“Ariseand thresh,
O daughter of Zion;For I will make your horn iron,And I will make your hooves bronze;You shall beat in pieces many peoples;I will consecrate their gain to the Lord,And their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.” [James 3:14] [Prov. 23:20 p [1 Cor. 6:9]] [Phil. 4:8] [1 Cor. 16:1; Heb. 13:16; 1 Pet. 4:9 z Matt. 25:35;]
